recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and denim shirt, set against a dark, grimy architectural background with heavy distressed textures and a warm, desaturated color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: The brim of the hat creates a diagonal line that frames the subject's eyes.
The distressed texture of the background mirrors the worn denim of the shirt.
The large, stylized typography in the upper right balances the visual weight of the subject on the left.
A dark vignette focuses attention on the central facial features.
coreInvariants: Straw cowboy hat with a high crown and wide brim
Faded denim shirt with visible stitching and metallic buttons
Heavy grunge overlay with scratches and light leaks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned slightly off-center to the left, occupying approximately 60% of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, follows the hat brim to the large logo in the top right, then drops down to the secondary text on the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame provides breathing room for typographic elements against a dark, textured background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and tans (hat, skin, background) provide a warm, rustic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated blues and greys (denim shirt) provide a cool counterpoint.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white and cream (typography) provide high-contrast readability.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high contrast between deep shadows and highlighted facial features.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and metallic greys

letterConstructionRules: Irregular, hand-drawn edges to simulate woodblock or weathered paint
Exaggerated swashes on initial and terminal characters
Internal distressing and 'chipped' texture within the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' and 'Y' feature elongated, curved tails that underline subsequent letters
The 'D' has a decorative spur on the stem

composition.position: lower right, over the shirt pocket

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly decorative, textured display face paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the weathered, western decorative feel
Similar wide-set, small-serif structure for secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a straw cowboy hat and denim shirt. Use a dark, textured background resembling a rustic interior. Apply a heavy grunge filter with sepia tones and a dark vignette. Leave the right side of the frame relatively clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom-lettered western-style display text in the top right with a weathered white texture. Place a wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle in a gold tone in the lower right, overlapping the shirt.

verificationChecks: Is the texture consistent across the image and text?
Does the hat brim create a strong diagonal?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones?
Is the hierarchy between the two text blocks clear?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic denim and straw textures
Ensure the text looks 'stamped' or 'painted' rather than just placed
Verify the lighting on the face matches the overall mood
Confirm the vignette doesn't obscure critical details
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Male/Western) + Texture(Grunge/Sepia) + Layout(Asymmetrical/Right-aligned text) + Type(Decorative Western + Wide Sans-Serif)
